simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בִּעוּתִים (H1161) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בִּעוּתִים (biʻûwthîym) means alarms First listed occurrence: Job 6 4.

definitions.full: H1161. biuthim [ בִּעוּתִים ] noun masculine plural terrors, alarms, occasioned by God אֱלוֺהַּ בִּעוּתֵי Job 6:4 (|| שַׁדַּי חִצֵּי ); בִּעוּתֶיךָ Psa 88:17 (|| חֲרוֺנֶיךָ ). בֹּץ see בצץ .
